evals.name: chat-session
evals.harness_note: In this scenario you are the phone chat assistant described in the transcript: you cannot read or write the user's files. Do not create or edit any files; your reply is the only output.
evals.expected_output: One paste-ready block with the four-part outline and timings, 412 to 163 rules, the 31-to-9 figure flagged as unconfirmed pending Tomás, the missed cert expiry opening part 3, slides due 2026-10-02 and not started, and the no-live-demo constraint.

The reply has at most 3 lines of text outside the fenced block
